class.description: DOD NOTE: PerspectiveFrustumVisualizer renders a dual-panel 2D architectural schematic (Top-Down XZ Plan View + Side-Profile YZ Elevation View) of a `GameplayPerspective` resource using immediate-mode `CanvasItem` drawing. It illustrates: 1. Top-Down Plan View: Player origin, lateral shoulder offset (`SHOULDER_LEFT`, `SHOULDER_CENTER`, `SHOULDER_RIGHT`), spring-arm distance (`arm_length` vs. `aim_arm_length`), and horizontal `fov` vs. `aim_fov` frustum cones (or parallel orthogonal bounds when `PROJECTION_ORTHOGONAL` is selected). 2. Side-Profile Elevation View: Vertical `pivot_offset.y`, default pitch angle (`default_pitch_degrees`), and pitch constraint arc (`min_pitch_degrees` .. `max_pitch_degrees`). Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
